en.headline: Empty red minibus overturns on Kwai Chung Road near Lai Chi Kok
en.dek: A driver-only public light bus struck a kerb and flipped onto Kwai Chung Road towards Tsuen Wan at 7.43 a.m., closing lanes near Mei Foo and sending the driver to hospital.
body: An empty red-top public light bus overturned on Kwai Chung Road towards Tsuen Wan near Lai Chi Kok Park at about 7.43 a.m. on Friday after it apparently lost control and hit a kerb, police and local reports said.

The minibus came to rest across traffic lanes with a badly damaged front end. White smoke was seen rising from the vehicle. The driver, who was the only person on board, climbed out and was treated for facial injuries before being taken to hospital.

The Transport Department said some lanes of Kwai Chung Road towards Tsuen Wan near Mei Foo Sun Chuen were closed after the crash and that remaining lanes were congested. Police were investigating how the vehicle left the carriageway.

zh.headline: 葵涌道空載紅VAN撞壤翻側 往荃灣交通受阻
zh.dek: 今早7時43分一輛只有司機的紅色小巴在葵涌道近荔枝角公園失控撞壤翻側，司機面部受傷送院，美孚附近部分行車線封閉。
body: 警方及本地傳媒報道，今早約7時43分，一輛空載紅色公共小巴沿葵涌道往荃灣方向行駛，至近荔枝角公園對開懷疑失控剷向路壤，隨後向右翻側，車身橫亘行車線。
現場所見小巴車頭嚴重損毀，泵把飛脫，車身冒出白煙。車上只有司機一人，他保持清醒並自行爬出，面部受傷，經救援人員包紮後送院治理。
運輸署表示，因交通意外，葵涌道往荃灣方向近美孚新邸部分行車線暫時封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線，上址交通繁忙。警方正調查意外起因。
